title: Everything Is Tuberculosis
author: John Green
summary: John Green traces the long history of tuberculosis and argues that a curable disease still kills over a million people a year because of inequality. He tells it partly through a young patient he met in Sierra Leone.
readIf: you want a short, humane look at global health and why a curable illness persists.
skipIf: you want a detailed medical or epidemiological text rather than a personal, advocacy-minded essay.
